## Course Overview

::: {.incremental}
- <span class="material-icons inline-icon">search</span>Identify a research question and advisor by week 3
- <span class="material-icons inline-icon">description</span>Draft a formal research proposal, workshopped in class
- <span class="material-icons inline-icon">verified</span>Prepare and submit an IRB application before data collection
- <span class="material-icons inline-icon">event_repeat</span>Biweekly check-ins to track progress against the proposal
- <span class="material-icons inline-icon">campaign</span>Present findings to the class at the end of the semester
:::
